sheets.prompt: Environment concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a wide establishing view of pale cream dunes under a sage green sky, a colossal rusted cog wheel sunk to its axle in the sand, its great teeth rising out of the dunes in a curve like a stair, each tooth carved and painted with pictures of a year (a birth, a flood, a dimming city, a festival of lanterns), small figures climbing the teeth and tying ribbons; round sinkholes in the dunes beside it show more giant gears turning below in a warm amber light; a village of domed huts at its foot, and far overhead an upside-down city hangs in the sky. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade glass fluid backpack walks along the top of the teeth in the foreground, for scale.
